svg.title: HyperOx mobile: Spaces
svg.text: M0.2b · design pass II · machine → spaces → tabs → split map · light = paper · dark = darkmatter

g.text: Pick a machine, then each space shows its tabs as a to-scale
map of splits. Every pane is a button (≥ 48 dp): name,
command, state. "Needs you" panes get the working-colour
Read-only map, same structure as the desktop sidebar. "Start
agent" per space opens the agent slots.
03 tablet / foldable · rail + spaces + big map · dark
Width ≥ 600 dp: tabs listed on the left; the selected tab is drawn large, each pane with a live preview of its last lines.
Slots come from the computer’s Settings › Agents.
Slots mirror the computer’s Settings › Agents (same numbers
as ctrl+shift+1–9). Picking one goes to the confirm dialog.
